node.title: PMA rate-half guarded fibers are exact complement-divisor linear slices
node.statement: For normalized labels (0,1,lambda), write E_c=L_1 Etilde and M=L_2L_3. Complementing an exact m-point core support S by D=L_C/L_S gives deg D=2ell-a, and the predecessor's guarded support condition is equivalent to deg rem_M(D Etilde)<=ell-a and gcd(D,rem_M(D Etilde))=1. Conversely every such monic divisor reconstructs one exact contributor. Since Etilde is a unit modulo M, the unguarded slice in K[X]/(M) has dimension ell-a+1 and codimension ell+a-1. Its degree-2ell-a truncation is linearly identical to the proved three-petal mu-basis space; if the guarded fiber is nonempty, its dimension is one below the half strip and ell-2a+2 in the live upper strip. This is an exact BC/SCK-shaped instance map, not a max-fiber bound or an ordinary-prefix conjugacy.
